text: One cardinal Yama Niyama to follow is to think before you talk. You will save 90% of the troubles of the world. If you are going to say something, which you think is going to cause trouble, keep quiet.
author: Sri M

text: Love is that you give with no expectations of ever receiving anything back.
author: Sri M

text: Brahmacharya does not mean that you become a total celibate. The meaning of the word Brahmacharya is all the charyas, which means all the processes required to reach the Brahman.
author: Sri M

text: When you find a spiritual teacher after a few years of observation, one who you think is worth it, ask for the real thing. Don’t ask for the petty stuff. Sometimes in trouble, one asks for such things, it’s okay. However, always keep in mind that what you have to look for is That.
author: Sri M

text: Tamo guna, through service, evolves to Sattva and the mind becomes purified. Not only do you progress upwards, but you also take along with you, those whom you have served. To me, service is a significant part of one’s spiritual life.
author: Sri M

text: ‘That which does not move’ – is that which is absolutely still like the eye of the cyclone, total motion but in the middle there is no movement – absolute calmness. And, it is from that calmness that everything is sucked in because it’s a vacuum. So that vacuum – ‘nothingness’ is very powerful.
author: Sri M

text: Most traditions talk about the ‘Energy’ being raised – it has to be raised from the lower Chakras to the higher. Chakra means a ‘Centre’ – a field of Force. You cannot find a chakra or a lotus – padma, if you were to dissect a body. It is merely a field in which a certain Force operates.
author: Sri M

text: When the so-called ‘limited’ being recognises and realises his inner essence, he begins to know and understand that he is not different from the Absolute.
author: Sri M

text: We need eyes to see an object. This is obvious. But we cannot see our own eyes except as a reflection in a mirror. Yet, we cannot say that the eye does not exist. It is because of the fact that the eye exists, we see things around us; similarly the ‘Atman’ or Consciousness. It is only because of this root identity that we are ‘alive’ and ‘conscious’. To realize this true identity is the main purpose of meditation.
author: Sri M

text: Good and evil, famous and notorious, darkness and light, positive and negative, all are in the Supreme Being and yet in its essential essence the Supreme Godhead is not affected by the opposites.
author: Sri M

text: Krishna says that if you would only fix your attention on ‘me’; He speaks not as a human being but as the manifestation of the Supreme Being. ‘If you fix your attention on me with complete faith and absolute attention and great love, then I will certainly save you from the ocean of birth and death.’
author: Sri M

text: The mind is distracted continuously because, for most people, the prana (vital energy) is working through the ida (left channel) and the pingala (right channel), which are meant for worldly things.
author: Sri M

text: If the body has not rested and is not alert, then it cannot meditate. It will impact the mind. So, keep your body in a state where it's not tortured by lack of sleep or extreme fasting.
author: Sri M

text: Yoga is not a passive state. It is a super-active state wherein there's action in the tranquillity of mind, without agitation.
author: Sri M

text: Don’t go to extremes. If you go to one extreme in this world, you might get thrown to the other. Moderation is the key.
author: Sri M

text: When the love for the Divine arises, it’s like an overflow. There are no questions.
author: Sri M

text: Ahimsa is an attitude of not causing injury to any living being, including human beings. Some people feed sugar to ants, but they have no problem pulling someone down when they go home.
author: Sri M

text: Don’t think that meditation happens only when you sit cross-legged in one place. Meditation is any activity that brings about love, affection, the calmness of mind, and tranquility leading to the ultimate goal.
author: Sri M

text: By serving somebody, you are actually doing nothing. The person whom you serve is giving you an opportunity to evolve. ‘You’ are not giving anybody anything. If you don’t, somebody else will provide. Nature’s law is that they will receive it somehow. We should have this in mind when we serve people.
author: Sri M

text: Aql ke madrase se uth, ishq ke maikade mein aa, Jaam-e-fana-o-bekhudi, ab to piya jo ho so ho Get up from the school of the intellect, come to the tavern of joy, intoxication. Now that you have drunk the wine of annihilation of the ego, whatever happens, let us enjoy.
author: Sri M

text: ‘Sat-sangha’ means a group of people coming together to know the Truth, to know goodness, to understand reality. Therefore, you should be surrounded by people, or you should try to go to a group of people living together who are also looking at the same thing.
author: Sri M

text: If anybody is selling or vending a formula that they claim will take you to Moksha, you should be suspicious. There is no such possibility. If there were, millions of people would have attained Moksha en masse. That is not possible. It is an individual affair. Every person has to work for themselves, and there are no shortcuts.
author: Sri M

text: Swami Vivekananda said, 'All the Gods that you see are only pictures created by people who have not seen them. But there are living Gods, human beings we can see face-to-face. Serving a human being is the greatest form of worship. It also purifies your mind and prepares you for the spiritual journey.
author: Sri M

text: One of the simple things people need to develop is single-pointed attention. This is useful in anything, material or spiritual, whichever way you choose to go in life.
author: Sri M

text: All beings are divinity in living form. Serving living beings is the best worship you can do. The more you help, the purer you become, and the clearer your mind becomes.
author: Sri M

text: On your spiritual quest, it’s not necessary to get detached from social relationships completely. That’s not required. In fact, it’s only while living in this world with others that one can discover what you are, who you are and where you stand.
author: Sri M

text: Kriya is one of the ways of yoga in which it’s understood that the state of one’s mind can be altered through varying the rhythm of your breathing.
author: Sri M

text: In the process of delving into the mind, there is a lot of churning. When you churn, just like the ancient ‘Samudra Manthan’ (churning of the ocean), the first thing that emerges is poison. Unfortunately for us, there is no Shiva around to consume it. This poison must appear first and then only will the Amrit (nectar) come.
author: Sri M

text: If you are seeking a spiritual teacher, get rid of the conventional ideas you may have about a teacher, because that prejudice may prevent you from seeing a real teacher.
author: Sri M

text: Each one of us, with our limitations, needs to understand the fact of how we are related to this world, and how, while we are still in this world, can free ourselves from it.
author: Sri M
